Klean by Geerho FAQ

For customers

Why do I have to verify my ID? Klean is one person, one account, for everyone: customers, staff and owners. Verification keeps points fair, stops fraud, and protects your wallet.

Does verification cost anything? No. Verification is free: Klean pays for the identity check. If you close the window halfway, you can reopen it.

Do I have to verify again later? No. Once you're verified, you stay verified, even if Klean ever adds a fee for new verifications.

Do you keep a copy of my ID? No. Our verification partner, Didit, handles the images. Klean keeps only your verification result, your verified name and country, and one-way codes used to detect duplicate accounts.

It says I already have an account. Tap Use my existing account to move this sign-in method onto your original account. If that doesn't work, contact support.

I paid but the machine didn't start. Your money is safe: a wash credit is waiting on Home. Scan any free washer at the same laundromat business and it starts without another payment.

Will the machine start by itself after I pay? No. For safety, a machine only starts when you start it: tap Start wash or Start dry on Home (Klean asks you to check that your laundry is inside and the door is closed), or press Start on the machine.

Can I just wash, or just dry? Yes, where the laundromat offers it. Choose Wash only or Dry only in Start laundry, or when you scan a washer. Scanning a dryer with nothing saved gives you a dry-only load. Prices are on the laundromat's page.

How do I dry my clothes? Every wash + dry load includes a dry. When your wash finishes, scan any free dryer at the same business. Home shows "Your dry is paid" with a Scan a dryer button.

I have lots of laundry. Do I pay for each washer? No. After you scan the first washer, choose how many loads (up to 5) and pay once. That washer starts; your other washes and all your dries are saved in your wallet. Scan each free washer or dryer and it starts with no payment.

How long do credits last? 30 days from purchase.

How do points work? Usually 10 points per paid load, plus a 10-point welcome bonus on your first paid visit to each business. 100 points = a free wash + dry. Each business can set its own numbers; Home shows them.

Do new members get a free wash? At laundromats that offer a welcome load, yes: if you verified in the last 30 days and haven't done laundry on Klean yet, your first wash + dry there is free. One per person across Klean.

Do I verify again at a different laundromat? No. You verify once, and your account works at every Klean laundromat.

Can I use points at a different laundromat? Only at branches of the same business where you earned them. Points from different businesses are kept separate.

Do points expire? Yes, 12 months after you earn them.

Can I pay cash? No. Klean takes GCash, Maya, QR Ph and cards in the Philippines, and cards elsewhere.

Why won't the app open without internet? Klean needs a live connection to take payments and start machines. Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data and it unlocks automatically. Machines already running aren't affected.

How do I delete my account? Account → Delete account. Unused points and credits are forfeited.

Why does Klean ask me to update? When a new version fixes something important, Klean shows "Update available", or "Update required" for older versions that can't be used any more. Tap Update (App Store, Google Play or TestFlight). Turning on automatic updates on your phone keeps you current without asking.

For laundromat owners (Super Admins)

How much does Klean cost? Free to download and set up, with no subscription. Klean takes a commission on each payment it processes (shown in Business → Setup). Payment-processor fees apply. Free loads redeemed with points carry no commission.

What hardware do I need? One Klean controller box per 4 coin-operated machines, plus a current sensor per machine: roughly ₱1,500–3,000 per machine in parts, bought ready-made or built yourself. Klean HQ's Hardware page and the Hardware Guide list the parts and show how to wire them. Your machines keep accepting coins.

Can I try Klean before installing anything? Yes. Every business starts in Beta: payments use test money, nothing is charged or paid out, and you can delete the test data any time. Open Klean HQ on a computer, add a location with simulated washers and dryers, and scan their QR codes with the Klean app.

How do I start taking real payments? Business → Setup → switch Beta testing off. You need your payout account set up and at least one real machine connected with a Klean controller. Going live deletes your beta data.

Can I change the commission? No. Only Klean sets the commission rate, and you'll get at least 30 days' notice of any increase. Each transaction uses the rate in effect when it was made.

When do I get paid? Klean pays you automatically once a day (around 2:00 a.m. Manila time): the day's sales minus Klean's commission, the payment processor's fees, and a ₱10 transfer fee in the Philippines. In the Philippines it goes to your GCash, Maya or bank account (in your verified name); elsewhere, to your Stripe account.

How do I add staff? They install Klean and verify their identity, then give you their member code. Enter it in Business → Staff.

Can a staff member work at more than one branch? Yes: assign them to any number of branches, or to all of them. Change it anytime.

Can I see who my customers are? You see display names, masked emails, points, visits, spend and usage times for people who use your laundromats. You don't see their ID or legal name.

Which reports can I get? Daily, weekly, semi-monthly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual and annual sales, with CSV export.

What happens if the shop internet goes down? Klean locks on every device until it's back online, and machine controllers show red. Keep reliable Wi-Fi, ideally with a mobile-data backup.

For attendants

Do I need a separate staff account? No. Your one personal Klean account gets staff access when your employer adds you. If you leave the job, your customer account stays yours.

A machine is red. What do I do? Read the reason on the card, check the machine, then tap Clear error. See the Moderator Handbook.

Can I ring up my own laundry? No. Ask another attendant, or use self-service scan like any customer.

How do I contact Klean? In the app: Account → Contact us. Or email info@klean.ph, or call or text (619) 796-1115. Include your member code (Account) so we can find your account. We will never ask for your password or sign-in codes.

Who runs Klean? Klean by Geerho is a business owned and operated by Geerho Tech LLC, a software company. Address: 2108 N St, Ste N, Sacramento, CA 95816, USA. Email info@klean.ph, or call or text (619) 796-1115.

What happens if my laundromat closes on Klean? Its points and free loads end, and you can't scan its machines any more. A laundromat can only close after every customer's paid loads there are used or refunded, so you never lose a load you paid for.

How does Klean know how many loads I need? Weigh your laundry on the laundromat's scale and enter the kilos in Start laundry. Each load is up to the laundromat's limit (usually 8 kg), so 9 kg is 2 loads. Pay once, then scan a washer for each load and a dryer for each dry.

Keep it simple. Keep it Klean.
No mess. No stress. Just spotless.
